linkedin:
Lean transformation sounds like a buzzword. Here is what it means in practice.

It is cutting the waste out of how work actually moves through your business: the handoffs, the waiting, the rework nobody planned for.

We map how the operation really runs, not how the org chart says it runs. We remove the steps that do not earn their place. Then we hand back a tighter version of the same business.

Same output. Less friction. Lower cost.

See where your own operation leaks with the free Operations Audit Workbook at tracestrategies.com.
